mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) and decreases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2) signal a dovish monetary response to inflation, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market contraction (HOUST < 900) indicates reduced residential investment and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during a housing downturn regime.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is below 900, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 98 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 98, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
